_comment: Per-platform HARDWARE parameters for the realistic model. Independent of roofline_model/config.json (do not reuse that one). The realistic Ring/Simple 0x7 model only needs 'a_us' (P2P RTT of a small message, fixed startup latency == alpha) and the NIC bandwidth (link_bw_GBs * efficiency). Calibrated overhead parameters live separately in overhead.json.

p5en.a_us_provenance: mean of pping RTT_us for msg<=32B

nic._comment: aggregate NIC bandwidth = link_bw_GBs * efficiency * 1e3 bytes/us.
